judgments.reason: The span 'fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23) 1241 RU/mL (<180)' appears literally in the vignette and documents a markedly elevated FGF23 level, which clinically supports the modifier that the osteomalacia is due to an FGF23-producing tumor.
